verdicts.reason: In listScript.sml, HD is defined by primitive recursion (new_specification) with only HD (h::t) = h, leaving HD [] unspecified and independent of the uninterpreted constant ARB. In CandleLean.Prelude.List, HD [] reduces definitionally to ARB, making HD ([] : List Nat) = ARB (and out-of-bounds EL returning ARB) provable in Lean while left open by HOL4's saved theorems.

In listScript.sml, LAST_DEF is defined by primitive recursion (new_specification) with only LAST (h::t) = if t = [] then h else LAST t, leaving LAST [] unspecified and independent of ARB and HD []. In CandleLean.Prelude.List, LAST [] reduces definitionally to ARB, making LAST ([] : List Nat) = ARB and LAST [] = HD [] provable in Lean while left open by HOL4's saved theorems.
